prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 50.8 °C (64% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 57.4 °C (48% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 55.8 °C (55% above healthy). Rapid temperature accumulation with minimal inlet-outlet drop indicates loss of cooling circulation.
Valve: small lag. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.67 s (within 1% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.47 s (2% above healthy). Hydraulic valve exhibits slight transient lag while maintaining target pressure.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 3.30 l/min (50% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 797 W·min/l (108% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 30.6 % (48% below healthy). Significant reduction in delivered volume flow at nominal electrical power indicates severe internal pump slippage.
Accumulator: slightly reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 56.8 bar (22% above healthy). Slight increase in pressure oscillations indicates reduced surge dampening capacity.

tslm_prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 51.6 °C (66% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 58.0 °C (49% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 56.4 °C (56% above healthy). Elevated hydraulic oil temperature and reduced heat dissipation across the exchanger indicate severe cooler malfunction.
Valve: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.40 s (within 1% of healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.64 s (within 2% of healthy). Directional valve actuates cleanly with no discernible switching hesitation.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 3.29 l/min (50% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 804 W·min/l (110% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 30.3 % (48% below healthy). High power-to-flow ratio demonstrates extensive internal leakage across the pump chambers.
Accumulator: severely reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 56.6 bar (21% above healthy). Dampening capacity is substantially impaired, producing high-frequency pressure oscillations across the circuit.
